correction_note: This registry supersedes the initial 420-row draft registry before any data download or evaluation. The acceptance rule 'no asset >50% of net profit' and same-day cross-asset cluster definition require each trial to be a 3-asset portfolio, not one separate trial per asset. No results were observed and no trial was executed. The prior registry hash is retained in Git history.
unit_of_trial: One indicator x timeframe x direction portfolio containing BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, and SOLUSDT; asset-level results are components, not separate hypothesis tests.
cluster_definition: Within each asset, trades cannot overlap. All trades opened on the same UTC calendar day across the three assets within a trial count as one independent cluster. Report trade rows, per-asset rows, and portfolio cluster count.
repository_alternates_reason: No repository-derived parameter setting has yet been verified and reviewed; no settings are invented.
known_spec_blocker: Kronos is restricted to post-training-cutoff data with cutoff no earlier than 2025-09-01, while A and B end on 2024-12-31 and C is sealed until final evaluation. Therefore Kronos has no eligible A/B selection data under the unified schedule; its two portfolio trials are blocked pending a non-leaking protocol resolution.
